svg.text: Rate limiting on Azure: six algorithms, three layers, one shared counter
The sample deployment behind the load test numbers
Container Apps environment: ASP.NET Core API, .NET 8, two replicas
Balanced B0, one Lua script per algorithm
classic: sliding window, v2: token bucket
tokens, not requests, for AI backends
Counter lives per gateway node, never aggregated.
so service-layer 429s do not eat gateway budget.
Counter lives in memory, per replica:
two replicas let 60 of 90 through where 30 were configured,
and 8 calls reached the slow dependency instead of 4.
One counter for every replica: 30 of 90 again.
Fails open when Redis is down. That is a choice; alert on it.
which layer rejected, per replica, Retry-After: docs/kql.md
Every reject is a 429 with Retry-After computed from the limiter's own state. Numbers from docs/load-test-results-azure.md, limit 10 per second per client.
